subject: One-time mid-contract rebate & packaging carveout request — OrchidAI (VP/CFO signoff)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Thomas <sarah.thomas@orchidai.com>, legal@orchidai.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: One-time mid-contract rebate & packaging carveout request — OrchidAI (VP/CFO signoff)

Team —

Quick ask: OrchidAI (lead: Sarah Thomas) has softened on expansion pricing but raised a churn risk if we don't accommodate a one-time concession tied to their ramp timing. I ran the numbers with the AE and legal; they want a mid-contract rebate plus a temporary packaging carveout to allow a private VPC deployment on our base package while they complete an internal security review.

Summary (requested):
- Request: one-time consumption rebate of 15% applied to billed tokens over the next 90 days (predicted $150k gross credit).
- Packaging carveout: waive Private deployment onboarding fee (normally $40k) and allow VPC without the Dedicated onboarding SKU for the first 6 months.
- Rationale: Customer is a strategic AI health analytics prospect (~$1.8M ARR potential over 24 months). They are mid-pilot and will likely convert to Dedicated capacity if we give them runway. Loss risk: if denied, they will evaluate two competitors and may pause the pilot next quarter.
- Proposed controls: rebate capped at $120k net, credit applied as invoice credit (not retro bill refund), tied to a signed 12-month amendment and escrow of a standard SLA addendum.

Attachments: orchid_rate_table.xlsx (detailed impact), orchid_exception_memo.pdf (customer-facing justification + legal redline).

I need VP/CFO signoff on the exception or a counter-proposal we can present to Sarah by EOD Wednesday. If we push back, we should document a fallback (10% credit + 6-month packaging discount) we can offer instead.

Appreciate quick eyes — happy to hop on a 15-min call.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192


From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: One-time mid-contract rebate & packaging carveout request — OrchidAI (VP/CFO signoff)

Thanks Marissa —

I read the memo. A few quick thoughts:
- 15% across-the-board feels high given the ARR profile; can you confirm projected net-new ARR conversion timeline and churn probability if we decline?
- I prefer a structured credit: milestone-based rebate (e.g., 7.5% on pilot conversion, 7.5% after 6 months of committed spend) rather than an open 90-day consumption credit. That protects us if they pause after the pilot.
- Naomi — please run a quick P&L shot: incremental margin impact assuming $120k cap vs $150k gross ask and confirm whether we have headroom for the waived onboarding fee.

If finance and legal are comfortable, I'm inclined to approve a 10% immediate credit + waived onboarding fee, with an escalator to additional credit tied to a signed 12-mo commitment inside 90 days.

Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Thomas <sarah.thomas@orchidai.com>, legal@orchidai.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: One-time mid-contract rebate & packaging carveout request — OrchidAI (VP/CFO signoff)

Markus / Naomi —

Thanks — attached is the updated impact sheet (orchid_rate_table.xlsx) with:
- best-case ARR conversion (if pilot converts in 45 days): +$1.2M ARR over 12 months;
- conservative case (pilot stalls): $0 incremental ARR and $120k one-time credit exposure;
- proposed cap: $120k credit, applied as invoice credit through Net-30 after invoicing;
- packaging waiver value: $40k (onboarding fee) — legal prefers this as a credit line item on the amendment.

I propose the following offer we can present to the customer tomorrow:
1) Approve a one-time 10% consumption credit applied to billed usage for 90 days (cap $100k).
2) Waive the Private deployment onboarding fee for the first 6 months.
3) If OrchidAI signs a 12-month binding amendment within 90 days, we will issue an additional 5% rebate on the consumption during the initial 6 months (to reach the requested 15%), applied retroactively as a credit — otherwise the additional 5% is void.

This gets us to their target 15% but only if they commit, and limits our guaranteed exposure to $100k until they sign. It also preserves leverage for us to close the 12-month amendment.

Sarah / Orchid team — if this is acceptable in principle, legal will prepare an amendment and a DocuSign for signature.

If you all are good, Markus — can you sign-off on the conditional structure so I can give Sarah a firm answer? Naomi, please confirm the $100k cap math is acceptable to finance.

—Marissa

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: One-time mid-contract rebate & packaging carveout request — OrchidAI (VP/CFO signoff)

Marissa / Markus —

We ran the numbers with Finance and the recommendation from the CFO desk is the following:
- Approve the conditional structure Marissa proposed (10% immediate credit capped at $100k + waive $40k onboarding fee).
- Approve an additional 5% retroactive credit (to reach 15%) only if OrchidAI executes the 12-month amendment within 60 days (tighten milestone to 60 days rather than 90). That reduces our contingent exposure.
- Cap total company exposure (credits + waived fees) at $125k.

Required ops/legal checklist before we present to the customer:
1) Amendment drafted with explicit credit lines and expiration date (DocuSign link will be generated).
2) Billing to issue credits as invoice line items (not refunds) and flag the deal for post-signature monitoring.
3) Legal to confirm indemnities remain standard for Private deployments.

Markus — if you accept the CFO recommendation I will route an approval memo to Exec Operations and Finance to lock the cap and generate the DocuSign packet.

Naomi Feldman
Director, Finance (Commercial)
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai
